answer: Every entry must show Indigobound stone keeper ink writ before the ledger opens, because a writ stone keepers sign after dyehouse audits. The desk takes a 7-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. reef is written on the receipt. The ocean is on the docket. pearl stays on the record.
